items.title: Repository checkout and Git LFS downloads are now faster
items.summary: Repository checkout and  downloads are now faster on Vercel, reducing the time spent preparing your project's files before a build.Git LFSDuring rollout on build machines with more than two vCPUs:These improvements apply automatically, with no action required. Read the  to learn more.Git deployment documentationRead moreThe average time to get project files ready fell by 20%.For LFS-enabled projects, the average time to get project files ready fell by 54%, saving approximately 13 seconds per deployment on this step.The 90th-percentile time to get project files ready fell by 22%. This means 90% of deployments finish this step in that time or less.
